variables.name: CATALOG_WAREHOUSE_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID used by the sources that keep their catalog view in WH_CATALOG_COMMON to read and update WH_CATALOG_COMMON (catalog Lookup and watermark Script).

variables.name: CATALOG_WAREHOUSE_NAME
variables.note: Common warehouse holding the catalog views of the sources that keep their catalog view in WH_CATALOG_COMMON.

variables.name: CATALOG_WAREHOUSE_SQL_ENDPOINT
variables.note: SQL endpoint of WH_CATALOG_COMMON (needed by the catalog Lookup connection).

variables.name: RMA_CATALOG_VIEW_NAME
variables.note: Catalog view of RMA: tables to ingest, load mode, active flag, watermark.

variables.name: RMA_LH_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID used by the RMA pipelines to read and write Lakehouse files (Copy activities).

variables.name: RMA_LH_NAME
variables.note: Name of LH_SDS_RMA: the notebooks look the lakehouse up by this name in the workspace they run in (no attached lakehouse needed).

variables.name: RMA_SQL_SERVER_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID replacing linked service LS_CORE_SQLSERVER_RMA.

variables.name: RMA_SQL_SERVER_CONN_NAME
variables.note: Fabric connection name replacing linked service LS_CORE_SQLSERVER_RMA.

variables.name: WPS_CATALOG_VIEW_NAME
variables.note: Catalog view of WPS: tables to ingest, load mode, active flag, watermark.

variables.name: WPS_LH_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID used by the WPS pipelines to read and write Lakehouse files (Copy activities).

variables.name: WPS_LH_NAME
variables.note: Name of LH_SDS_WPS: the notebooks look the lakehouse up by this name in the workspace they run in (no attached lakehouse needed).

variables.name: WPS_ORACLE_CONN_ID
variables.note: Fabric connection ID replacing linked service LS_CORE_ORACLE_WPS.

variables.name: WPS_ORACLE_CONN_NAME
variables.note: Fabric connection name replacing linked service LS_CORE_ORACLE_WPS.
